issue: Schema recap listed only required Review-item fields; Feedback and IsJudgmentItem were used by Hard requirement 5 but not enumerated.
resolution: Updated Hard requirement 1 to enumerate optional Review-item fields (Feedback, IsJudgmentItem, IsOtherItem, Passes, HumanAction/Expectation legacy pair) so the field list matches actual schema and the prompt is self-consistent.

issue: Uses free-form VERIFY for the negative SSN-not-masked assertion because the W0 grammar does not have a negated VERIFY TEXT form.
resolution: Free-form VERIFY is the only option today per the grammar at https://github.com/darndestdabbler/dabbler-uat-dsl/blob/main/grammar/DabblerUatDsl.g4 (verifyTextStep has equals/contains/matches but no negation). Free-form emits // PENDING in generated test code per the grammar comments. Tracking as a W0 grammar-enhancement request: add  and  forms. Defer to W2 (uat-runner-and-triage-feedback) or a dedicated W0 patch.
